title: 008 一国之师（番外完结）
content_zh:
平清殿。
玄同微微侧首：“飞轩赢了。”
天正帝坐在龙椅上，微微闭着眼睛：“是这样吗。”
门在此时被轻轻推开，飞轩缓缓踏了进来，李凡松单手按住剑柄，等在门外。
“我今天一直在想，会不会最后还是你推开这扇门。”天正帝依然闭着眼睛，似乎非常疲倦。
“很失望吗？”飞轩问道，似乎并不因对方的身份而有任何的敬畏。
天正帝笑了笑，睁开眼睛：“还好吧。老国师死前留下过遗命，希望你能继承他的衣钵，担任本朝的国师之位。虽然你还年少，但是几位钦天监的老天师都挺你，若这次道统大会你证明了自己的实力，那么开国以来最年轻的国师，必定是你了。”
“只可惜，我是那个人的朋友。”飞轩说道。
天正帝轻轻摇了摇头：“我知道，我不如他。”
“敢问陛下，何为一国之师？”飞轩忽然问道。
天正帝犹豫了一下：“为何有此所问？”
“钦天监不过是一个负责观测天象，占卜吉凶的机构，监正的官职也并不高，而国师更只是一个虚称。可为何人们会如此看重？那是因为国师代表着一国的信仰至高，而身为国师，心中所系只是这个国家。我师父齐天尘为救国而身死，可陛下却在怀疑我们钦天监对北离的忠诚。”飞轩俨然不再是那个懵懂的小童，一字一句掷地有声，“是否太低估我们钦天监了！”
天正帝沉吟半饷，终于缓缓开口：“以后飞轩，是否还愿意相信孤？”
“陛下此番行为虽然低估了我钦天监，却从未对飞轩起过杀意。陛下只是心不安，飞轩理解。”飞轩转过身，“只是国师之位，师父传给了我，我不能让。”
“怕是赶不上了。”天正帝手轻轻地敲着龙椅。
“那也要赶过再说。”飞轩转过身，朝着门外跑去。
天正帝看着他的背影，良久之后说道：“玄同，拟旨吧。”
清静院。
“青城山飞轩，可在！”主事官见三炷香已灭，朗声喝道。
“青城山飞轩，可在！”

“青城山飞轩，可在！”
三问之后，主事官转过身：“青城山飞轩未能到场，此番对决……”
“在！”忽有一声猛喝传来。
主事官扭过头。
“飞轩在此！”有时一声怒喝，怒喝之中，似有龙象怒吼！
“好纯粹的大龙象力！”谭泽赞叹道。
“青城山飞轩，在！”只见那小道童从屋顶之上一掠而下，狠狠地砸在了地上，引起尘土飞扬，他扬起头，“久候了。”
雷无桀恍然大悟：“这才是真正的飞轩。”
兰月侯幽幽地说道：“看来，不仅仅是我这儿没办好差事。”
飞轩望向玄择：“可是龙虎山的弟子。”
玄择一愣，也望向飞轩，对上的全是金黄色的瞳孔，那双瞳孔带着无上的威势，玄择心中竟然一怯，微微往后退了三步，低声道：“这就是大龙象之力……”
“大龙象之力已经到了第六重，这个时候，道法功力若是和他有一定距离的，会自然而然地产生畏惧。”谭泽说道，“飞轩的天赋，真的是卓绝。”
“你和那位羽衣卿相是师兄弟？”飞轩缓缓问道。
玄择又往后退了一步。
飞轩笑了笑：“他已经逃走了。”
玄择咽了口口水，汗如雨下。
“你呢？”飞轩轻轻挥了挥右手。
“我放弃。”玄择抬起了手，在众人诧异的目光走下了台。
“为何？”有龙虎山弟子不解。
“走！”玄择低喝一声，朝院外走去。

“这样看来，便只剩下一轮了。”谭泽伸手摸了摸自己的胡须，“青城山对武当山，这就有意思了。这几百年来，两家关于道门魁首的争夺，一直就没有停歇过。大龙象力，对纯阳无极功，谁能赢？”
主事官清了清嗓子：“道统大会最终一轮对决，青城山飞轩，对武当山，落飞！”
然而飞轩站在台上之后，却遇到了上一轮一模一样的情况，武当落飞，不见踪影。
“又要等三炷香？”兰月侯笑着望向老天师。
老天师没有说话，雷无桀倒是先说话了：“我觉得怕是没有必要了。”
清静院外，一个道袍的清瘦身影越走越远，总是一脸瞌睡，似醒非醒的落飞伸了个懒腰：“真麻烦。”
千里之外，武当山上，几个年轻人正在院中和仙风道骨的老道长一起晒太阳。
“你们说，我们落飞现在在天启怎么样了？”老道长的声音微微有些担忧。
叼着马尾巴草的年轻人眯着眼睛：“肯定是名扬天启了啊。”
“那么远跑一趟，结果还不让他和齐天尘还有赵玉真的弟子打一场，多遗憾啊。”老道长长叹道。
“萧瑟，要是失败了怎么办？”一身黑衣的年轻人没有躺着晒太阳，而是站在屋里，跟着身边的一个小道士学着打太极。
“失败了，就让雷无桀把那清静院炸了！”萧瑟挠了挠头。
“这是个好办法。”在萧瑟旁边，同样晒着太阳的叶若依笑道。
司空千落一枪打在了萧瑟的身边：“萧瑟，等雷无桀回来以后，我们能回雪月城了吗？”
“这么着急回去做什么？”萧瑟不解。
“去和我爹提亲！”司空千落长枪一扫，把萧瑟从那椅子上打了下来。
唐莲哈哈大笑：“小师妹，这是着急了啊。”
清静院内，武当落飞再也没有出现，这一次道统大会的魁首终于还是被青城山的飞轩拿了。一个小童胜了道统大会，却是几十年来都不曾出现过的情况。
“这也是萧瑟那家伙安排的？”兰月侯问道。
雷无桀叹了口气：“早知道这家伙安排了这么厉害一个道士来，我半路就去找叶将军了。”

“叶啸鹰？”
“对啊，我着急提亲呢。”
“侯爷，宫里的圣旨到了。”一名内监走到了兰月侯边。
兰月侯笑了笑，望向台下的飞轩：“小飞轩，以后怕不只是小天师了，还是小国师了啊。接旨吧。”
content_en:
Pingqing Palace.
Xuantong tilted his head slightly: "Feixuan won."
Emperor Tianzheng sat on the dragon chair and closed his eyes slightly: "Is that so?"
The door was gently pushed open at this time, and Fei Xuan slowly stepped in. Li Fansong held the hilt of his sword with one hand and waited outside the door.
"I have been thinking today whether it will be you who opens this door in the end." Emperor Tianzheng still had his eyes closed and seemed very tired.
"Are you disappointed?" Fei Xuan asked, not seeming to have any awe because of the other party's identity.
Emperor Tianzheng smiled and opened his eyes: "It's okay. The old Imperial Master left a legacy before his death, hoping that you can inherit his mantle and serve as the Imperial Master of this dynasty. Although you are still young, several old Imperial Masters from Qintian Prison support you. If you prove your strength in this Taoist Conference, then you will definitely be the youngest Imperial Master since the founding of the country."
"It's a pity that I am that person's friend." Fei Xuan said.
Emperor Tianzheng shook his head gently: "I know, I am not as good as him."
"May I ask Your Majesty, what is the master of a country?" Fei Xuan suddenly asked.
Emperor Tianzheng hesitated for a moment: "Why do you ask this?"
"The Qintian Prison is just an institution responsible for observing astronomical phenomena and divination of good and bad luck. The official position of the supervisor is not high, and the National Preceptor is just a false title. But why do people value it so much? That's because the National Preceptor represents the supreme belief of a country, and as a National Preceptor, the heart Our master Qi Tianchen died to save the country, but His Majesty is doubting our Qin Tianjian's loyalty to Beili." Fei Xuan no longer seemed like an ignorant child, and said loudly, "Have you underestimated our Qin Tianjian?"
Emperor Tianzheng pondered for a long time, and finally spoke slowly: "Feixuan, are you still willing to trust Gu in the future?"
"Although His Majesty underestimated me, Qin Tian Jian, with this behavior, he never had any murderous intention towards Fei Xuan. Your Majesty is just uneasy, Fei Xuan understands." Fei Xuan turned around, "It's just the position of National Master. Master passed it on to me, I can't let it go."
"I'm afraid I won't be able to catch up." Emperor Tianzheng tapped his hand gently on the dragon chair.
"Then we have to get over it first." Fei Xuan turned around and ran towards the door.
Emperor Tianzheng looked at his back and said after a long time: "Xuan Tong, draw up the decree."
Qingjingyuan.
"Qingcheng Mountain Feixuan, you are here!" The officer in charge shouted loudly when he saw that the three sticks of incense had been extinguished.
"Qingcheng Mountain Feixuan is here!"
"Qingcheng Mountain Feixuan is here!"
After three questions, the officer in charge turned around and said: "Qingcheng Mountain Feixuan failed to arrive. This duel..."
"Here!" Suddenly there was a loud shout.
The officer in charge turned his head.
"Feixuan is here!" Sometimes there was an angry shout, and in the midst of the angry shout, there seemed to be a dragon and elephant roaring!
"What a pure dragon elephant power!" Tan Ze praised.
"Qingcheng Mountain Feixuan, here!" I saw the little Taoist boy swooping down from the roof and hitting the ground hard, causing dust to fly. He raised his head, "I've been waiting for a long time."
Lei Wujie suddenly realized: "This is the real Feixuan."
Lan Yuehou said quietly: "It seems that it's not just me who didn't do the errands well."
Fei Xuan looked at Xuan Ze: "But he is a disciple of Longhu Mountain."
Xuan Ze was stunned and looked at Fei Xuan. All he saw were golden pupils. Those pupils were filled with supreme power. Xuan Ze felt frightened and took three steps back slightly. He whispered: "This is the power of the big dragon elephant..."
"The power of the big dragon elephant has reached the sixth level. At this time, if the Taoist skills are at a certain distance from him, he will naturally be afraid." Tan Ze said, "Feixuan's talent is really outstanding."
"Are you and that Yu Yi Qing Xiang a fellow apprentice?" Fei Xuan asked slowly.
Xuan Ze took another step back.
Fei Xuan smiled: "He has escaped."
Xuan Ze swallowed, sweating like rain.
"What about you?" Fei Xuan waved his right hand gently.
"I give up." Xuan Ze raised his hand and walked off the stage in front of everyone's surprised eyes."Why?" Some Longhu Mountain disciples were puzzled.
"Let's go!" Xuan Ze shouted and walked out of the courtyard.
"It seems like there is only one round left." Tan Ze reached out and touched his beard, "Qingcheng Mountain versus Wudang Mountain, this is interesting. Over the past hundreds of years, the two families have been fighting for the leader of the Taoist sect. Who can win against the power of the dragon and the elephant versus the pure Yang Wuji Kung Fu?"
The officer in charge cleared his throat: "The final round of the Taoist Conference, Qingcheng Mountain Feixuan, vs. Wudang Mountain, Luofei!"
However, after Fei Xuan stood on the stage, he encountered the same situation as the previous round. Wudang flew away and disappeared.
"We have to wait for three more sticks of incense?" Lan Yuehou looked at the Heavenly Master with a smile.
The Heavenly Master did not speak, but Lei Wujie spoke first: "I don't think it's necessary."
Outside the Qingjing Courtyard, a thin figure in Taoist robes walked further and further away. He always had a sleepy look on his face, and Luo Fei stretched his waist and said, "It's really troublesome."
Thousands of miles away, on Wudang Mountain, several young people were sunbathing in the courtyard with an old Taoist priest with a fairy-like style.
"Tell me, how are we, Luofei, doing in Tianqi now?" The old Taoist's voice was slightly worried.
The young man holding the horsetail grass in his mouth squinted his eyes: "He must have become famous."
"It's such a pity that after traveling so far, he was not allowed to fight with Qi Tianchen and Zhao Yuzhen's disciples." The old Taoist sighed.
"Xiao Se, what should I do if I fail?" The young man in black did not lie down and bask in the sun, but stood in the room and learned Tai Chi from a little Taoist priest next to him.
"If you fail, let Lei Wujie blow up the Qingjing Courtyard!" Xiao Se scratched his head.
"This is a good idea." Next to Xiao Se, Ye Ruoyi, who was also basking in the sun, smiled.
Sikong Qianluo shot Xiao Se's side: "Xiao Se, after Lei Wujie comes back, can we return to Xueyue City?"
"Why are you going back in such a hurry?" Xiao Se was puzzled.
"Go and propose marriage to my father!" Sikong Qianluo swiped his spear and knocked Xiao Se off the chair.
Tang Lian laughed loudly: "Little junior sister, you are in a hurry."
In Qingjing Courtyard, Wudang Luofei never appeared again. This time, the leader of the Taoist Conference was finally taken away by Fei Xuan of Qingcheng Mountain. A child defeated the Taoist Conference, but this was something that had not happened in decades.
"Is this arranged by that guy Xiao Se?" Lan Yuehou asked.
Lei Wujie sighed: "If I had known that this guy had arranged for such a powerful Taoist priest to come, I would have gone to find General Ye halfway."
"Ye Screaming Eagle?"
"Yes, I'm anxious to propose marriage."
"Master Marquis, the imperial edict from the palace has arrived." An internal eunuch walked to Lan Yuehou.
Lan Yuehou smiled and looked at Feixuan in the audience: "Xiao Feixuan, from now on I am afraid that I will not only be a little heavenly master, but also a little national master. Take the order."
